principles.text: Simulate inaccessible surfaces, but label them honestly
principles.interpretation: When blocked from direct execution, simulation is valid work — not excuse-mode. But simulated sections must be clearly marked as simulation, not presented as completed execution.

principles.text: Reverse engineer now so activation later is immediate
principles.interpretation: Turn-key preparation pattern: do all possible work now so that when access is granted, activation is a single step, not a project.

principles.text: One master sync file beats scattered text-file relays
principles.interpretation: Multi-agent coordination converges on a single artifact. Fragments across chats and files create entropy. One document = one source of truth for the wave.

principles.text: Repo + log sweep feeds the master document, not side notes
principles.interpretation: Full repo harvesting compresses into one operator-readable master document. Side notes, scattered comments, and informal logs are sources — not destinations.

system_design_insights: A single shared markdown control plane lets multiple command stations converge on one artifact instead of spraying fragments across chats and text files.
Simulation is not excuse-mode. It is a turn-key preparation lane when live access is blocked.
Full repo and log harvesting should compress into one operator-readable master document.
